answer: Each applicant takes a meadow-bracket vertex, locking a 70-credit bond, 15-credit fee. Each epoch zephyr draws random pairings; each pair finishes one task, winner takes both bonds, the meadow board republishes hashes for recompute. Three wins admit at 25 work each: 1,000 fake vertices cost 90,000 vs 40,000 rewards; honest pays 90 once, keeps its bond. Bracket-farming rings fail: zephyr redraws pairings each epoch, duplicates burn both bonds.
